title: Samsung's New Monitor Trades Resolution for Extreme Speed

sources.name: Samsung U.S. Newsroom
sources.title: Samsung Launches Odyssey G6: The World’s First 1,100Hz Gaming Monitor

sources.name: NVIDIA GeForce
sources.title: How To Reduce Lag - A Guide To Better System Latency

sources.name: VESA
sources.title: VESA® Adds ‘Adaptive-Sync’ to Popular DisplayPort™ Video Standard

paragraphs.en: Samsung announced the American launch
paragraphs.zh: 三星宣布在美國推出

paragraphs.en: of its 27-inch Odyssey G6 monitor
paragraphs.zh: 旗下27吋Odyssey G6螢幕，

paragraphs.en: on November 23, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 日期是2026年11月23日。

paragraphs.en: The company plans retail availability from December.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司計畫從12月開始在零售通路供應。

paragraphs.en: Its headline feature is a choice:
paragraphs.zh: 最受矚目的功能，是提供一項選擇：

paragraphs.en: up to 1,100Hz at HD resolution,
paragraphs.zh: 在HD解析度下，更新率最高可達1,100Hz，

paragraphs.en: or up to 600Hz at QHD resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 或在QHD解析度下，最高可達600Hz。

paragraphs.en: The highest speed therefore comes with a resolution trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，最高速度伴隨解析度上的取捨。

paragraphs.en: QHD mode offers 2,560 by 1,440 pixels,
paragraphs.zh: QHD模式提供2,560乘1,440個像素，

paragraphs.en: while HD mode uses a lower resolution.
paragraphs.zh: HD模式則使用較低的解析度。

paragraphs.en: The two settings emphasize different goals:
paragraphs.zh: 這兩種設定強調不同目標：

paragraphs.en: a more detailed picture or more frequent screen updates.
paragraphs.zh: 更細緻的畫面，或更頻繁的螢幕更新。

paragraphs.en: Samsung calls the switching feature Dual Mode.
paragraphs.zh: 三星將這項切換功能稱為Dual Mode。

paragraphs.en: The announcement presents both choices
paragraphs.zh: 公告同時介紹這兩種選擇，

paragraphs.en: as options for different types of games.
paragraphs.zh: 供不同類型的遊戲使用。

paragraphs.en: Refresh rate describes how often
paragraphs.zh: 更新率描述的是頻率，

paragraphs.en: a display can update each second.
paragraphs.zh: 也就是顯示器每秒能更新多少次。

paragraphs.en: At 1,100Hz, the interval between refreshes
paragraphs.zh: 在1,100Hz時，兩次更新之間的間隔

paragraphs.en: is about 0.91 milliseconds.
paragraphs.zh: 大約是0.91毫秒。

paragraphs.en: That is a calculation from the advertised frequency,
paragraphs.zh: 這是根據宣稱頻率計算出的數字，

paragraphs.en: not a measurement of the total delay
paragraphs.zh: 並非量測完整延遲的結果，

paragraphs.en: between pressing a button and seeing a reaction.
paragraphs.zh: 完整延遲指的是從按下按鍵，到看見反應之間的時間。

paragraphs.en: Those are different quantities.
paragraphs.zh: 兩者是不同的量。

paragraphs.en: The advertised pixel response time
paragraphs.zh: 宣傳中的像素反應時間

paragraphs.en: is another separate measure.
paragraphs.zh: 又是另一項獨立指標。

paragraphs.en: Samsung lists one millisecond for gray-to-gray changes,
paragraphs.zh: 三星列出的灰階到灰階變化時間為一毫秒，

paragraphs.en: based on internal testing and specified settings.
paragraphs.zh: 依據是內部測試及指定設定。

paragraphs.en: This describes a pixel changing between gray values.
paragraphs.zh: 這描述的是像素在不同灰階值之間的轉換。

paragraphs.en: It does not describe the entire computer's response.
paragraphs.zh: 它並不是描述整部電腦的反應。

paragraphs.en: The company notes that content and settings
paragraphs.zh: 該公司提醒，內容與設定

paragraphs.en: can affect the results.
paragraphs.zh: 可能影響結果。

paragraphs.en: Smooth motion also involves coordination
paragraphs.zh: 流暢動態也涉及協調，

paragraphs.en: between the computer and display.
paragraphs.zh: 需要電腦與顯示器互相配合。

paragraphs.en: VESA, the display standards organization,
paragraphs.zh: 顯示標準組織VESA

paragraphs.en: explains that a computer's rendering rate can vary.
paragraphs.zh: 說明，電腦的算繪速率可能改變。

paragraphs.en: A mismatch with the display's refresh timing
paragraphs.zh: 如果它與顯示器更新的時序不一致，

paragraphs.en: can produce tearing or stuttering.
paragraphs.zh: 就可能造成畫面撕裂或卡頓。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive synchronization allows the display
paragraphs.zh: 適應性同步讓顯示器

paragraphs.en: to follow the computer's rendering pace.
paragraphs.zh: 能跟隨電腦的算繪節奏。

paragraphs.en: This addresses consistency as well as speed.
paragraphs.zh: 這同時處理了穩定性與速度問題。

paragraphs.en: Matching these timings does not itself
paragraphs.zh: 讓這些時序一致，本身並不會

paragraphs.en: make the computer create more frames;
paragraphs.zh: 使電腦產生更多畫格；

paragraphs.en: rendering still depends on the computer's workload.
paragraphs.zh: 算繪仍然取決於電腦的工作負載。

paragraphs.en: Compatibility matters at these extreme rates.
paragraphs.zh: 在這些極高更新率下，相容性很重要。

paragraphs.en: Samsung's notes say AMD FreeSync Premium
paragraphs.zh: 三星的註解表示，AMD FreeSync Premium

paragraphs.en: does not support the 1,100Hz setting.
paragraphs.zh: 並不支援1,100Hz設定。

paragraphs.en: They also say macOS does not support Dual Mode
paragraphs.zh: 註解也指出，macOS不支援Dual Mode，

paragraphs.en: or the native maximum rate of 600Hz.
paragraphs.zh: 也不支援原生最高600Hz的更新率。

paragraphs.en: The largest number on the specification sheet
paragraphs.zh: 規格表上最大的數字，

paragraphs.en: therefore needs to be read alongside
paragraphs.zh: 因此需要搭配

paragraphs.en: the conditions attached to it.
paragraphs.zh: 其附帶條件一起閱讀。

paragraphs.en: NVIDIA's background guide breaks system latency
paragraphs.zh: 輝達的背景指引將系統延遲

paragraphs.en: into delays in input devices,
paragraphs.zh: 拆分為輸入裝置中的延遲、

paragraphs.en: the computer, and the display.
paragraphs.zh: 電腦中的延遲，以及顯示器中的延遲。

paragraphs.en: Display delay itself includes processing
paragraphs.zh: 顯示器延遲本身，也包括處理時間，

paragraphs.en: and the time needed to update pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 以及更新像素所需的時間。

paragraphs.en: A faster panel can improve one part
paragraphs.zh: 更快的面板可以改善其中一部分，

paragraphs.en: of this chain, while the other parts still matter.
paragraphs.zh: 但這條鏈中的其他部分仍然重要。

paragraphs.en: It cannot by itself define the whole experience.
paragraphs.zh: 它本身無法決定整體體驗。

paragraphs.en: The launch illustrates how monitor makers
paragraphs.zh: 這次推出新產品，說明了螢幕製造商

paragraphs.en: are pursuing both sharper images and faster motion.
paragraphs.zh: 正在同時追求更銳利的影像與更快速的動態呈現。

paragraphs.en: Dual Mode makes that balance visible
paragraphs.zh: Dual Mode讓這種平衡更清楚，

paragraphs.en: within one product.
paragraphs.zh: 並把兩種選擇放在同一項產品中。

paragraphs.en: Understanding the news means keeping resolution,
paragraphs.zh: 理解這則新聞，需要將解析度、

paragraphs.en: refresh rate, pixel response, and total latency distinct.
paragraphs.zh: 更新率、像素反應時間及總延遲分清楚。

paragraphs.en: Each describes part of how a moving image appears.
paragraphs.zh: 每個指標都描述了動態影像呈現過程中的某個部分。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the monitor announcement and its significance?

choices.text: Samsung announced that the monitor reaches 1,100Hz at every resolution and on every system.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第一段將1,100Hz與HD模式連結，第六段也列出相容性限制。

choices.text: Samsung removed resolution choices to focus only on pixel response.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段說明兩種模式有不同目標，並非取消解析度選擇。

choices.text: The announcement proves that all computer delay has been eliminated.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三與第七段都區分螢幕相關指標與整體系統延遲。

choices.text: Samsung announced a monitor offering a resolution-speed choice, whose performance figures describe different things.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一與第二段介紹模式取捨，其餘段落解釋更新率、像素反應及總延遲等不同指標。

quiz.explanation: 主旨是新產品提供解析度與速度的選擇，而規格數字仍須分別理解。最高更新率不等於所有模式、所有平台或整體延遲的共同表現。

evidence.quote: The highest speed therefore comes with a resolution trade-off.
Understanding the news means keeping resolution, refresh rate, pixel response, and total latency distinct.

quiz.question: What can reasonably be inferred from the approximately 0.91-millisecond refresh interval?

choices.text: It is the measured time for every button press to produce a visible response.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確說這不是按鍵到畫面反應的總延遲量測。

choices.text: It describes timing derived from the refresh frequency, while other system delays remain relevant.
choices.explanation: 正確。第三段說明計算來源，第七段則列出輸入裝置、電腦與顯示器等延遲環節。

choices.text: It guarantees that any computer creates 1,100 different game frames every second.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段說電腦算繪速率會改變，不能由顯示器更新間隔推定電腦一定產生相同數量的新畫格。

choices.text: It is a measurement of resolution rather than timing.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段描述的是時間間隔，解析度則在第二段以像素數說明。

quiz.explanation: 數學換算所得的更新間隔，只描述更新頻率的一個時間面向。本文沒有用它代表整個輸入到顯示的流程，也沒有把它當成電腦算繪輸出的保證。

evidence.quote: That is a calculation from the advertised frequency, not a measurement of the total delay between pressing a button and seeing a reaction.
A faster panel can improve one part of this chain, while the other parts still matter.

quiz.question: Why does the article discuss synchronization and compatibility?

choices.text: To show why the display must work with the computer and why maximum specifications have conditions.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段說明算繪與更新需協調，第六段則列出功能與平台限制。

choices.text: To claim that every adaptive synchronization feature supports the maximum rate.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段明確指出AMD FreeSync Premium不支援1,100Hz設定。

choices.text: To prove that display timing cannot affect visible motion.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段說時序不一致可能造成撕裂或卡頓。

choices.text: To replace the announced HD and QHD modes with an unrelated screen size.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。這些段落補充模式條件，並未改變螢幕尺寸或替換模式。

quiz.explanation: 只看最大數字無法完整理解產品。顯示器需配合電腦輸出，特定同步技術與平台也有支援範圍，因此文章同時交代協調機制與限制。

evidence.quote: A mismatch with the display's refresh timing can produce tearing or stuttering.
The largest number on the specification sheet therefore needs to be read alongside the conditions attached to it.
